card.name: Words just before the word risk
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words right before the word risk, such as at, of, high, increased or remain at. It responds when the next word is expected to be risk.

modes.description: The word of in phrases about assessing risk factors.
modes.example: based on an assessment<< of>> individual patients' underlying risk factors.
